submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Refine ONE final Dragon Heads-raising Day banner for 五行奇谈, opaque edge-to-edge 2098 x 749 pixels, 2.8:1.
Input image 1 is the approved PRIMARY style and character reference (Mid-Autumn banner), input image 2 supplies approved refined painting quality only (mail interface; never copy its text or UI), input image 3 is the Dragon Heads-raising Day banner EDIT TARGET. Preserve image 3's early-spring morning, rounded polished hand-painted finish, exact golden-headband Taoist boy identity and jade/ivory clothes, cheerful face, jade-and-gold bamboo dragon kite, wooden string spool, little dish of golden popcorn, willow shoots and teal mountain scenery.
Make one composition refinement for safe margins and usable text space: reduce the dragon kite about 20 percent and move it down/right so its entire golden horns, mane, bamboo frame and long ribbon tail are comfortably inside the canvas, with at least 35 pixels of sky above its highest tip. Keep the kite in the right half beside and above the boy, visibly a crafted bamboo-and-paper Chinese dragon kite, not a living dragon. Preserve coherent continuous bridle/string connection to the boy's pinching hand and spool. Raise the boy's lowest shoe a little so the complete shoe outline and sole have at least 30 pixels of foreground beneath, keeping the face and both hands unchanged and the boy on the right third. Do not crop or enlarge the whole image.
The left 45 percent should remain a quiet, softly layered scenic area: reduce the contrast and fine-detail density of the distant temples and foliage there with natural soft atmospheric perspective, retaining spring mountains, green fields and pale clouds. Keep the right foreground character and kite crisp, fully rounded and detailed. Maintain the same clean luminous exposure without blown-out whites or metallic glare. Preserve anatomically coherent hands, natural thumb/finger grip, exactly two arms and two visible shoes.
No writing of any kind, no pseudo-writing, numbers, watermark, logo, border, UI, split panels, collage, extra characters, living dragons, giant moon, rabbit or mooncakes. Return only the finished single banner.

submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE final independent traditional Chinese festival event banner for the Taoist fantasy game 五行奇谈.
Canvas: target native 2098 × 749 pixels, very wide landscape 2.8:1, opaque edge-to-edge illustration. Never a whole interface or a contact sheet.
Input image 1 is the PRIMARY approved style, chibi-character and horizontal-composition reference. Input image 2 is the approved mail interface context; use its painting quality only, never copy UI frames, borders, controls or writing.
Preserve the reference's refined rounded Chinese hand-painted fantasy art: precise polished contours, full rounded shapes, rich but restrained painterly detail, convincing cloth/stone/foliage volumes, jade and teal landscape, ivory cloth, warm gold accents, clean air and soft depth. Luminous but properly exposed highlights. Premium 2D illustration, not flat vector or plastic 3D.
Character on the RIGHT THIRD: one small chibi Taoist boy, the same large brown eyes, rosy round face, short spiky brown hair, golden headband with knot and two ribbons, jade-green gold-trim vest over ivory robe and trousers, golden yin-yang gourd on belt. Big head and short limbs. Keep his face, hands and all important props within safe edges.
LEFT 45% stays comparatively quiet: softly layered distant scenery and mist or sky, suitable for future overlaid text, but do not paint any text. Foreground thematic props concentrate on the right. Do not place the character on the left.
ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT: no Chinese or English characters, pseudo-writing, numerals, calligraphy, watermark, logo, UI border, graphic frame. Plain lanterns and plain packets must have NO characters. No giant moon, mooncakes, rabbit or Mid-Autumn osmanthus. Change the scene to the festival below instead of copying the reference night setting.
Rendering goal: highest available refined finished painting; the host manages the model and quality.
Festival-specific scene: Theme: Dragon Heads-raising Day (龙抬头), a fresh bright early-spring morning. On the right the boy delightedly holds a beautiful SMALL Chinese dragon kite, jade green with warm gold mane and long slender tail, clearly a handcrafted kite with visible bamboo framework and a string spool in his other hand, not a living dragon. A little dish of golden popcorn on the stone ledge is secondary. New willow shoots and soft spring clouds, quiet teal mountains and green fields on the left. The dragon kite is the dominant festival symbol; no lantern-filled night, no giant dragon.
